description.en: The AppName of the live stream.

descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口查询转码配置信息。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You must obtain the streaming domain before you call this operation to query the transcoding configurations.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 60 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-transcode-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-transcode-name example.com --app-name myapp --region cn-hangzhou
